fn power2(k: Int) -> Int
  requires (k >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (k == 0) then 1 else (2 * power2((k - 1)))))
  effects pure
  example (power2(0) == 1)
  example (power2(1) == 2)
{
  if (k == 0) then 1 else (2 * power2((k - 1)))
}

fn largestProperDivisor(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 1)
  ensures (result == largestProperDivisorHelper(n, 2))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures (result < n)
  ensures ((n % result) == 0)
  ensures forall d in (result + 1)..n: ((n % d) != 0)
  effects pure
  example (largestProperDivisor(2) == 1)
{
  largestProperDivisorHelper(n, 2)
}

fn largestProperDivisorHelper(n: Int, d: Int) -> Int
  requires (n > 1)
  requires (d >= 2)
  ensures (result == (if ((d * d) > n) then 1 else if ((n % d) == 0) then if ((n / d) == d) then (n / d) else if ((n / d) > largestProperDivisorHelper(n, (d + 1))) then (n / d) else largestProperDivisorHelper(n, (d + 1)) else largestProperDivisorHelper(n, (d + 1))))
  ensures (result >= 1)
  ensures (result < n)
  ensures ((n % result) == 0)
  ensures forall k in (result + 1)..n: ((n % k) != 0)
  effects pure
  example (largestProperDivisorHelper(2, 2) == 1)
{
  if ((d * d) > n) then 1 else if ((n % d) == 0) then if ((n / d) == d) then (n / d) else if ((n / d) > largestProperDivisorHelper(n, (d + 1))) then (n / d) else largestProperDivisorHelper(n, (d + 1)) else largestProperDivisorHelper(n, (d + 1))
}

  requires forall i in 0..len(queries): ((2 <= queries[i]) and (queries[i] <= (power2(25) - 1)))
  ensures (len(result) == len(queries))
  ensures forall i in 0..len(result): ((result[i] >= 1) and (forall i_ in 0..len(queries): exists c in 1..(26 + 1): (((((power2(c) - 1) >= queries[i_]) and ((c == 1) or ((power2((c - 1)) - 1) < queries[i_]))) and ((not ((power2(c) - 1) > queries[i_])) or (result[i_] == (power2(c) - 1)))) and ((not ((power2(c) - 1) == queries[i_])) or (result[i_] == (if ((power2(c) - 1) <= 1) then 1 else largestProperDivisor((power2(c) - 1))))))))
